summary:
The hand-written sections now describe revision r4: 52 decisions, 52 settled, 0 open. The strict build has no warning, `check.mjs` ends with "All checks passed.", and a new browser profile shows "52 / 52 answered" at 1440 px and at 400 px with no console error and no sideways page scroll.

Skills loaded after `git remote -v` (origin is github.com/ariakit/visonaut): `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-code-style`. No visonaut-specific skill is installed.

Main results:

1. `sections/15-your-answers.html` is the entry point of r4. The table "Decisions that need you" is gone. In its place: the two answers of this round, one code example of the new capture list form, and one list "What still needs your word" with 11 items (anchor `#your-answers-word`). The section has 7,215 reader words against 7,222 in r3 (-7).
2. The code example replaces the `oidc.ts` example. It is a short copy of the two examples in `#data-inventory-pages` and `#data-inventory-example` of section 40. It leaves out fields and adds none:

```jsonc
// The page index of the real Ariakit run: 913 bytes. Left out: 4 fields of the run, and the
// first and the last capture of each page.
{
  "schemaVersion": "capture-pages-v1",
  "captureCount": 3832,
  "pages": [
    { "digest": "3c701b8c…", "bytes": 830885, "captures": 2000 },
    { "digest": "61cd1fd5…", "bytes": 782492, "captures": 1832 }
  ]
}
```

3. The order-of-work demo now has each of the 52 decisions in a step (a script checked it). Step 1 is "Facts and your word". D-DATA-02 is in step 5 (service part, with D-RUN-02) and in step 9 (CLI part). D-OPS-04 is in step 9, which is the last cutover of the pinned values.
4. The D-OPS-04 part of section 35 and the D-DATA-02 part of section 40 keep their evidence, numbers, tables, and demos. Only the framing changed: each part starts with "Settled in revision r4: ...", "Recommendation" became "Your answer", and "The recommendation is wrong if" became "What would make you change the answer". The question of D-DATA-02 (one run, or all runs together) stays in section 40 as an open fact: "One question has no answer."
5. `95-feedback.html` now says that the record needs no answer, that an answer can still change, and that implementation and GitHub publication are out of scope until the maintainer authorizes them separately.
6. `decisions.json`: 1 prose sentence changed (listed in decisionProseChanges). A script confirmed that no id, status, option list, option id, label, `recommended` flag, `settledAnswer`, `short`, `question`, or `evidence` changed.
7. One gap in the tooling, which I did not change: with 0 open decisions, `check.mjs` skips 8 of its 37 cases for each output (`if (first)` at check.mjs:418, where `first` is the first open decision). The log has 116 pass lines, where r3 had 148. I ran those mechanics on a settled decision with a script in my scratch folder, and they pass.

Not done, because it is not in my task: I did not publish the artifact. `apps/lab/audit/dist/visonaut-audit.html` and `apps/lab/public/audit/index.html` are built and ready. I changed no file outside `apps/lab/audit/content` and my scratch folder `/Users/diegohaz/.claude/jobs/f65a6229/tmp/round4/editor/`. `record.json`, `terms.json`, `findings.json`, and `sections/70-design-lab.html` are byte-equal to their state before my work.
